creator: sirakinb
title: 'Your AI needs hands': three things to give a business AI agent - an always-on cloud workspace with file storage, a memory of business data, and hands (tool logins, schedules, outbound API calls)
claims: Everyone's AI has a mouth, few have hands; the models are fine but they can't touch anything

Three requirements: (1) a place to work - an always-on cloud computer plus storage for files/images/videos; (2) memory - where customers, numbers, history live so each session doesn't start from scratch; (3) hands - log into tools, run on a schedule without being asked, reach other services (pull leads, generate images, grab data)
Caption names an 'agent-native stack: api gateway (business tools), data pipes, ce...' (truncated)
how_to_steps: Give the agent an always-on cloud machine + file store
Give it a persistent business-data memory
Give it tool credentials, a scheduler, and outbound integrations
on_screen_only: Title cards: 'YOUR AI NEEDS HANDS'; '01 A PLACE TO WORK - COMPUTER + FILES'; '02 MEMORY - YOUR BUSINESS CONTEXT'; '03 HANDS - TOOLS + ACTIONS'; 'WORKSPACE + MEMORY + HANDS'

implement_score.why: Nothing concrete to implement; it is a mental model. The Jarvis/Hermes recipes already liked are more specific.
